outcome: Escalation: Tola checks a raised escalation, the PMO Lead decides "Escalate to the client" or "Don't escalate", and Tola drafts Message v1 for internal review, in four states (contract mock only)
acceptance_criteria: **Four states from data.** `/work/W-3601` to `W-3604` show their fixture's status label and tone, facts, Tola's card, decide panel, quote, Message v1, Next line and links, and nothing else. No board string is in `src`: `grep -rn "INVESTIGATING\|YOUR DECISION\|NOT ESCALATED\|MESSAGE DRAFTED\|Escalate to the client\|Don't escalate\|FACTS AND DATES" frontend/src` returns nothing. — verify: `cd frontend && npx vitest run tests/escalation.test.tsx`; pages at 1440 and 390.

**Tola's work is shown, never a decision.** On W-3601 the card shows "Tola", "step 3 of 4", WORKING, the four steps with their details as returned, "Started 13 Nov 11:00" and "Ask Tola" (href `/assistant`). There is no decide control. On W-3604 the card shows DONE and the three done details. On W-3602 and W-3603 no visible card is drawn. Changing a fixture step's `source` changes only that text. — verify: component tests on the fixtures and modified copies.

**Unknown is never 0.** W-3606 shows "Unknown" for "Delays" and "Already asked the client". The page has no "0", "0 TIMES", empty value cell or "-" or "—" in their place. — verify: component test on W-3606.

**The page counts and dates nothing.** Changing "3 TIMES" to "4 TIMES", or "15 DAYS LATE" in the facts, changes only that value; Message v1's dates are not reread or reformatted. `git diff -U0 frontend/src | grep -nE "parseFloat|Number\(|\.reduce\(|new Date\("` adds nothing. — verify: component tests on modified copies; the grep.
**Sample-marked.** Every fixture page shows `SampleLabel` because `sample: true`; a copy with `sample: false` does not. — verify: component test.
**Controls only from `you_can_act` and `required_role`; nothing from `/me`.**

**Escalate.** On W-3602 the page sends one claim to `/api/v1/tasks/T-3602/claim`. "Escalate to the client" then sends exactly one POST `/api/v1/tasks/T-3602/decision` with CSRF and `{verdict: "approve", expected_revision: 1}`: no note, no extra keys, valid against the generated schema. A double press sends one. The re-read shows MESSAGE DRAFTED from `W-3602.approve.json`. — verify: component test; e2e request log.

**Don't escalate needs a note.** An empty or blank note, or one over 2000 characters, sends nothing; "Add a note to reject it." appears under the note, announced, with focus on the note. With a note, one POST with `verdict: "reject"` and the trimmed note follows. The re-read shows NOT ESCALATED with the quote and "Back to the issue" linking to `/work/W-3609`, which opens ISS-0241. On the phone, "Don't escalate" opens the full-height `Drawer` with the note. — verify: component tests; e2e at 390.

**No success before the re-read.** With the decide answering 200 and a test double still serving the decide state on re-read, the page shows neither MESSAGE DRAFTED, NOT ESCALATED nor "is approved". The buttons follow the re-read task. — verify: component test with a recording `fetch`.
**An uncertain decide never reads as success.**

**Backend refusals are shown.** With `psl_mock_scenario` 403 the decide shows the read-only view; 409 shows the stale view, keeps the note and resends only on a new press; 422 shows the message under the note. — verify: component tests; `tests/escalation-mock.test.ts`.

**Send for review.** On W-3604, "Send for review" sends one POST `/api/v1/work/W-3604/steps` with CSRF, `expected_revision`, `step: "send_for_review"`, `inputs: {}` and a UUID `idempotency_key`. A retry after a 500 reuses the key. On 200 the re-read shows WAITING FOR REVIEW, with no Approve, Send or Return control for `pm`. The page never shows "sent for review" before the re-read. — verify: component test; e2e request log.

**A missing reviewer is a hold.** On W-3608 "Send for review" is unavailable with the returned `disabled_reason`, no POST is sent whatever is pressed, and no reviewer's name appears. — verify: component test with a recording `fetch`.

**Nothing says sent to the client.** On every fixture, sidecar and notice in this feature, `document.body.textContent` contains none of: "sent to", "was sent", "has been sent", "delivered", "received", "This sends to the client". No new fixture step sets `sends`. Message v1 has no Send, Approve and send, or Edit control. — verify: component test over W-3601 to W-3609 and the sidecars; `grep -n '"sends"' frontend/mock/fixtures/work/W-36*` returns nothing.

**Frame.** The crumbs read Projects / Lagoon Health / Registers / Escalations / ESC-0012 as returned. The project tab bar links every tab and marks none current. The phone bar shows "← Project" to `/projects/P-0101` and "ESC-0012" on all four states. F-30's issue pages and F-33's income pages draw as before. — verify: component tests; e2e.
**Phone.**
**Fidelity (D-64, D-83).** One design-fidelity run per round over the 8 boards, on a production build at `--width 1440` and `--width 390`.

**Accessibility.** There are no axe violations (`wcag2a`, `wcag2aa`, `wcag21a`, `wcag21aa`, `wcag22aa`) at 1440 and 390. This covers W-3601 to W-3604 and W-3608, the open Drawer, the note error, the uncertain notice and the not-open view. Also:

**Tokens and components only.** The diff adds no `#hex`, `rgb(`, `hsl(` or raw px outside tokens in any `.css`. It adds no local copy of an `@/components` export (`Button`, `Drawer`, `TextArea`, `Callout`, `Panel`, `Tag`). — verify: grep on the diff.
**Mock matches the contract.** In `tests/escalation-mock.test.ts`:

**Contract not extended.** `git diff --stat` shows no change in `frontend/src/api/**`, `frontend/src/features/decide/**`, `InlineDecide.tsx`, `proposals.ts`, `src/shell/**`, `mock/server.mjs`, `mock/workspace.mjs`, any existing fixture, `apps/**`, `architecture/**`, `design/**` or the protected paths. No new overlay field is added; every reused or recorded one is listed in build.md. — verify: `git diff --stat`; build.md.

**Existing tests green.** `delivery/checks.sh` passes, and the tests listed under Context pass unchanged. — verify: `delivery/checks.sh`; `cd frontend && npx vitest run` and the e2e command under Lanes, pasted in build.md.

**build.md evidence.** It records the commands and results, the 8 scores and waivers, every exception with its Conflicts number, the overlay and backend list, and the held list. It states that nothing reaches the client in part 1. — verify: file content.

risk.rationale: Medium. Part 1 has several behaviours on the shared workspace block (F-17): an agent checklist, a claim-and-decide with a required note on refusal, and a step write. It also adds additive contract proposals (X-VERDICTS, the escalations enum, cites, links), so SURFACES are ui, api and contract-change. It is not high and has no external-messaging surface, because nothing reaches the client in part 1. The decision only allows a draft that still faces review in part 2. Authority is never decided in the browser, only rendered from `you_can_act` and `required_role` (schema.d.ts:1364-1365), so the auth surface is not ticked. PRODUCT-ACCEPTANCE is required because the escalate and don't-escalate decision, its wording and the drafted client message are new flows the client must see.
